integrity: The proof starts from the source's exact two-permutation vertex formula, separates the centered squared norm into a fixed quadratic term and one inner-permutation roughness statistic, computes the statistic's first two moments by exact sampling-without-replacement identities, and derives the covariance from coordinate-permutation invariance and the trace. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns regular nested permutohedra with arithmetic alpha and beta sequences and appropriate positive parameters. It determines the complete vertexwise radial formula and second moments, not extreme radii, inradius, or John--Loewner ellipsoids. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent permutation-statistic moment calculation under terminology not mentioning nested permutohedra.
title: Exact radial second moments of regular nested permutohedra
